findings.description: Cinderella Bakery, trading on Balboa Street since 1953, opened a 3,500-square-foot second location in this building on 28 August 2026, in the space La Victoria Bakery formerly occupied.

citation.label: SFist, “This Week In Food: Cinderella (Bakery) Story,” 28 August 2026

publish.note: Past this run's three-page cap, and it needs one judgement made before it goes up. The headline is the entry, and this one — “This Week In Food: Cinderella (Bakery) Story” — is a weekly column's title. It happens to be about this bakery, which is why this is pending rather than declined like the column's other items, but a column headline on a building's century-deep timeline is a thin thing to carry. Publish it only if no dedicated story turns up; the opening itself plainly earns an entry.
